thread:
elena.pm: Reminder  vendor roadmap sync TOMORROW 9am PT. Focus: lock embargo windows, SKU-freeze cutoffs, wave ordering for H100/H200, MI300, Gaudi/B200, and fallback routing policy.

sam-partners: Two quick asks for vendors: 1) confirm embargo_days numeric, 2) provide preferred wave id (A/B/C) and sku_freeze_date.

press_ops: Historically NVIDIA asked ~10d, AMD ~7d. We'll collect exact numbers; if any vendor requests >14d we loop legal early.

kai-infra: Infra conservative targets: H100 Dedicated GA mid-June; H200 late July; MI300 shipments late June (APAC +10d). Gaudi revB patch ETA mid-May — if slips, Gaudi -> Wave C.

si_marta: SI priority: H100/H200 first, MI300 next for quant paths, Gaudi/B200 last for cost lanes. Need canary images, driver bundles, and an integration window.

vendor_bot: Preflight form: https://forms.redwood.example/preflight-hw-2025 (fields: eta_signoff, embargo_days, wave_id, sku_freeze_date, microcode_embargo_bool, region_limits). Auto-remind 12h.

elena.pm: Proposal: Wave A = H100 (invite-only canary + early Dedicated); Wave B = MI300 + H200 (hosted + Dedicated); Wave C = Gaudi + B200 (economy lane). Space ~2-3 weeks, conditional on embargoes.

ravi-plg: Add fallback rule in runbook: if a vendor misses a wave cutoff, auto-route to compatible family and mark listing with "compatibility_family" and a WF-fallback tag.

press_ops: Runbook snippet for "late-driver": hold public announce, call vendor triage, enable regional UI fallback, notify customers. Owner: partner-ops + press.

kai-infra: Canary telemetry baseline: 30d retention; infra will provision buckets for Wave A canaries and attach cost estimate. Recommend 100-instance golden canary.

si_marta: Ask vendors for quant export scripts or prebuilt int8/4bit artifacts. That reduces SI onboarding time significantly. Also list cloud-image diffs (AWS/Azure/GCP).

legal: Note  microcode/firmware labeled embargoed triggers IP review. Capture boolean in the form to auto-route to legal.

elena.pm: Action items: vendors fill preflight, infra publish canary plan + cost, marketplace draft SKU taxonomy + region flags, SI upload integration checklist. Who presents compatibility matrix? Ravi?

ravi-plg: I'll present the matrix and upload a PDF by EOD.

elena.pm: If you can't make 9am PT DM me for a 1:1 vendor follow-up. See you tomorrow. :calendar: :rocket:
